heading: Lab tests
description: The tests and panels the laboratory offers: how each is collected, how its result is read and what it is charged as. Samples and results are kept by the laboratory, not here.
backToList: Back to the list of lab tests

form.codeHint: How the test is known on orders and reports. It cannot be changed later.
form.name: Name
form.kindHint: A panel is a set of tests ordered together, such as a lipid profile. It cannot be changed later.
form.resultTypeHint: A number is read against reference ranges. Text is for results such as positive or negative.
form.chooseResultType: Choose how the result is recorded
form.unitHint: Optional. The unit of the result: g/dL.
form.containerHint: Optional. What the sample is collected in: EDTA tube.
form.turnaroundHoursHint: How long a result usually takes from collection, from 1 to 720 hours.
form.serviceHint: Optional. The laboratory service of the price catalog this test is billed as.
form.serviceSearchPlaceholder: Code or name of a service
form.serviceMore: The first {{count}} services are offered. Type above to find another.
form.serviceFailed: The services could not be loaded.
form.serviceUnavailable: The price catalog is not open to you, so the service cannot be changed here.
form.componentsHint: In the order they are reported.
form.componentsNone: No test has been added yet.

create.heading: Add a test
create.description: A test or a panel the laboratory offers. Reference ranges are set once the test is added.
create.codeTaken: This hospital already has a test with that code. It may be archived.

detail.notFoundBody: There is no such lab test at this hospital.
detail.errorTitle: The test could not be loaded
detail.archivedNote: This test is archived. It stays on the orders and reports that name it and is not offered for new ones.
detail.conflict: Someone else changed this test while you were editing. What you changed is still here: check it and save again. The fields you did not change keep what they saved.
detail.theySaved: They also changed something you changed. Saving puts your value in place of theirs:
detail.hasRanges: This test has reference ranges, which a text result cannot have. Remove the ranges first.
detail.inPanel: This test is part of a panel that is in use. Take it out of the panel first.
detail.linked: A service of the price catalog

ranges.heading: Reference ranges
ranges.description: What is normal for this test, by sex and age. A range for one sex is used before a range for any. A result already reported keeps the range it was reported against.
ranges.none: No reference ranges yet. Results are reported without one.
ranges.failed: The reference ranges could not be loaded.
ranges.conflict: Someone else changed these ranges while you were editing. Yours are still here. Saving again puts yours in place of theirs; cancel to see theirs.
ranges.noLonger: This test no longer takes reference ranges.

editor.untilValueHint: Not included. Empty: no upper age.
editor.ageNote: A patient moves to the next range on the day they reach its age, counted on the calendar from the date of birth. Where two ranges meet, give the same age in the same unit: until 1 year, then from 1 year.

errors.untilAfterFrom: This age must be later than the age the range starts from.
errors.oneLimit: Give a lowest or a highest normal value.
errors.highAboveLow: This must be above the lowest normal value.
errors.criticalLow: This must not be above the lowest normal value.
errors.criticalHigh: This must not be below the highest normal value.
errors.overlap: Another range for the same people already covers some of these ages, or could for some dates of birth. Where two ranges meet, give the same age in the same unit.

check.heading: Which range applies?
check.description: Enter an age and a sex to see the saved range a result would be read against. A real patient's age is counted from the date of birth to the day the sample was collected.
check.notFound: No range covers a patient of this age and sex. The result would be reported without one.
